address.note: Village centre, Mastichari, Kos. No street address is published on the client's instruction; see docs/CLIENT-QUESTIONS.md item 6.

map._note: Resolved from the client-supplied maps.app.goo.gl short link on 2026-08-28; every value here was read off that redirect, none inferred. This is the business's own Google Business Profile ('Mastichari Massage'). Coordinates are the village-centre point Google already publishes on the public listing - NOT a home address, and nothing finer is published. This pin is the studio, the only place the service is given since 2026-09-14. No ChIJ-form place ID is stored: it cannot be derived from the featureId without a Places API lookup, and Google returns HTTP 200 for a wrong one, so a guessed value would fail silently. Add it only from an API response or the Place ID Finder.
map._embedNote: embedUrl added 2026-08-28 for the studio-map section on the home and location pages. Resolved by following https://maps.google.com/maps?cid=<cid>&output=embed (no API key, no billing) to its actual redirect target, which is Google's own maps/embed endpoint keyed to this exact business listing via cid - not a generic coordinate marker. Loading it is the only third-party request this site makes; see server/security.js frame-src and the Cookies section of the privacy policy, which now discloses it.

studio._note: Only venue since 2026-09-14: the client confirmed he no longer travels to hotels, apartments or villas and now treats exclusively at his own place in Mastichari, which is what the Google Business Profile pin marks. It is NEXT TO the family's Ghitonia souvenir shop, not the same premises - do not conflate them. No street address supplied, and Google's public listing does not expose one in server HTML, so every language locates it by landmark plus the Maps link. Both walk-ins and appointments are accepted. If the client later supplies a street number, set streetAddress and add it to the PostalAddress in jsonld.njk.
